CommunityApplications.Profile: MetaMagic is a Plex library manager with a first-class GUI — the power of Kometa-style library management with granular per-item control and mass operations, no YAML required. Browse huge libraries, edit metadata and artwork, build automatic collections (franchise, studio, MediUX auto-sync), burn in poster overlays, and request missing movies from Radarr/Sonarr. This repository holds the official Community Applications template and the public support tracker.
